description: This file defines an abstract PHPUnit test case class 'EndpointTestCase' for testing API endpoints within the OrangeHRM system. It contains utility methods to set up mock requests, expect specific exceptions, and validate error handling in API endpoints.

classes.name: EndpointTestCase
classes.description: An abstract test case class providing utility methods for testing API endpoint behaviors, such as request creation, exception handling, and validation assertions, within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getRequest
methods.description: Creates and returns a new API Request object initialized with query parameters, request data, and attributes.

methods.name: getApiEndpointMockBuilder
methods.description: Returns a mock builder for a specified API class, preconfigured with a mock request containing given request parameters.

methods.name: expectNotImplementedException
methods.description: Sets the expectation that the test will throw a NotImplementedException.

methods.name: expectRecordNotFoundException
methods.description: Sets the expectation that the test will throw a RecordNotFoundException.

methods.name: expectBadRequestException
methods.description: Sets the expectation that the test will throw a BadRequestException.

methods.name: expectInvalidParamException
methods.description: Sets the expectation that the test will throw an InvalidParamException.

methods.name: expectForbiddenException
methods.description: Sets the expectation that the test will throw a ForbiddenException.

methods.name: assertInvalidParamException
methods.description: Asserts that executing the provided closure results in an InvalidParamException with expected invalid parameter keys.
